anakis_agreed_find_sister.m:
Thank you. My sister has long hair and is wearing a long skirt.

Please take care. Fangwurm the priest in western Brimhaven told us about a Basilisk in the cave that will turn you to stone when you go near him and your eyes meet its eyes.

anakis_at_home_angry.m: Go away. I don't want to talk to people like you.

anakis_at_home_morning.m: Thank you for trying to help my sister. I am so sad.

anakis_at_home_thanks.m: Thank you so much for helping my sister Juttarka. We are all very happy.

anakis_can_you_take_revenge.m: Can you find the Basilisk and kill it? And maybe there is a way to help my sister. But take care that the same fate that happened to my sister does not befall you.
r: I already found the Basilisk and killed it.
I will take revenge, but first tell me how I might help your sister.
I can't imagine how to help your sister but I will take revenge for her and find a way to kill that Basilisk.
No, that's too dangerous for me.
I only found a stone statue that looks almost like a real woman. [Describe the statue to Anakis]
I found the Basilisk and killed it, but I decided to take the blood for myself.
I found the Basilisk and killed it.
I found no way to help your sister, but I took revenge and killed the Basilisk.
I will take revenge, but let me first think if it is possible to help your sister.

anakis_help_find_sister.m:
Hello my name is Anakis. I hope you can you help me. 

Yesterday my sister Juttarka left the city to go up to this hill. She did not come home and now I am searching for her. I fear she went into that cave.
r: I found a statue that looks almost like a real woman. [Describe the statue to Anakis]
Yes, I will search for your sister.
No, that's none of my business.

anakis_meet_2nd_time.m: Hello again. Can you please help me to find my sister Juttarka?
r: I found a statue looking almost like a real woman. [Describe the statue to Anakis]
Yes, I will search for your sister.
No, that's none of my business.

anakis_sad_blood_not_use_for_sister.m: Oh no. Why did you not even try to help her? Now i will go and mourn for my sister.

anakis_talk_to_priest.m: I have no idea how to help her. But maybe Fangwurm the priest in western Brimhaven has some information.

anakis_thank_finding_sister.m:
Oh no, that's her! Thank you for helping me to find out what happened to her. 

I think it was the Basilisk who did that to her.

anakis_thank_healing_sister.m: Thank you so much for rescuing my sister Juttarka. She just came out of the cave and told me what you did for her. I will now go home, too.

anakis_thank_taking_revenge.m: Thank you for taking revenge for Juttarka. I will go now and mourn for my sister.

quick_glance_hidden_found_statue.30: Decided what to do with the Basilisks blood
quick_glance_hidden_found_statue.40: Killed Basilisk and left the room
quick_glance_hidden_found_statue.50: Told Fangwurm about keeping the blood for myself
quick_glance_hidden_found_statue.60: Told Fangwurm about killling the Basilisk

quick_glance.10: I talked to Anakis. He told me that his sister, Juttarka, went into the cave and did not come out again.
quick_glance.15: I denied to help Anakis to find his sister, Juttarka.
quick_glance.20: I agreed to help Anakis find his sister, Juttarka.
quick_glance.40: I found a stone statue that looked almost like a real woman.
quick_glance.50: I told Anakis about the statue. He thinks that it is his sister, Juttarka, and thanked me for helping him.
quick_glance.60: Anakis asked me if I could avenge his sister.
quick_glance.70: I agreed to avenge Anakis' sister, Juttarka, and kill the Basilisk.
quick_glance.75: I should talk to Fangwurm, the priest of west Brimhaven, to see if he has some information about how it may be possible to help Anakis' sister.
quick_glance.77: Fangwurm told me that the Basilisk's blood has special properties. It can protect against damage if applied to the skin. Fresh, warm, Basilisk's blood might even be able to heal a person that has been turned to stone.
quick_glance.78: The priest Fangwurm told me that the potion maker in Fallhaven sells special crystal vials that are resistent to the blood of a Basilisk, and I will need one to handle it.
quick_glance.79: I should search the other rooms in this cave for a mirror that I can use to protect me from the glance of the Basilisk.
quick_glance.85: I saved the life of Anakis' sister Juttarka.
quick_glance.90: I told Anakis that I killed the Basilisk.
